text:
mara - AE: Quick sync: FinisHealth wants a 7-day Private POC. Onprem inference runners + AWS VPCs. They demand <50ms RTT. Which connectivity pattern we recommend and what security caveats?

kevin - solutions eng: TL;DR: For sub-50ms, colocating connector in same AZ as customer egress is best. Options: 1) Interface endpoints (PrivateLink) per-VPC — low blast radius, quick; 2) TGW/Transit with IGW egress — fewer endpoints but more path complexity. For latency, PrivateLink usually wins due to local ENI hop.

sunil - netops: Operational notes: For PrivateLink, ensure per-AZ ENIs so failover doesn't hairpin. Required firewall rules: allow outbound TCP/443 to our endpoint ENI IPs, allow ephemeral high ports for streaming if using WebSocket chunking. NAT implications: if they SNAT at the edge, we can't preserve client IP. For preserve-src-ip use 1:1 NAT or route without SNAT. Also BGP required only for transit/TGW handoffs.

zoe - security: Compliance: we support customer-managed KMS in Private, TLS1.3 recommended, mutual TLS supported on request. For TLS inspect: if their DLP terminates TLS, mutual TLS breaks; recommend bypass rules for our endpoints. We'll provide SOC2 attestation and an encryption-in-transit statement for the questionnaire.

mara - AE: They asked about cost mid-PoC: endpoint hour fees vs inter-AZ/data transfer. Kevin, can you give a short estimate for a 7-day POC expecting ~6TB egress?

kevin - solutions eng: Ballpark (region dependent): PrivateLink endpoint ~ $0.015/hr per endpoint + data processing ~$0.01/GB. For 6TB (~6000GB) data cost ~ $60. Endpoint hours (2 endpoints * 24 * 7 * $0.015) =~ $5. So endpoints are inexpensive for short POCs. Inter-AZ transfer + NAT egress could be larger depending on topology. We'll include a compact cost sketch in the ticket.

sunil - netops: Firewall example they can paste: 
```
# allow outbound to redwood private endpoint ENIs
- proto: tcp
  ports: [443]
  dest_cidr: ["10.20.30.0/28", "10.20.31.0/28"]
  description: "Allow Private deploy traffic to Redwood ENIs"
# If using proxy passthrough: allow ephemeral ports for streaming
- proto: tcp
  ports: [1024-65535]
  dest_fqdn: ["connect.redwood.ai"]
```
Notes: replace ENI CIDRs with the exact list we'll upload. For preserve-client-ip: disable SNAT on the path to the ENI or use 1:1 NAT.

zoe - security: Questionnaire additions: SAML/SCIM SSO steps, audit log retention options (30/90/365 days), customer KMS options, and recommended TLS passthrough rules for DLP. We'll draft the responses.

mara - AE: Action items: sunil -> upload ENI CIDRs + paste firewall snippet into ticket FIN-POC-112, kevin -> cost sketch for 6TB 7-day POC, zoe -> questionnaire draft & TLS inspect callouts. Aim EOD PT.
